scope: Local Linux x86-64, JDK 27, Frida 17.24.3 FFM allocation-control fixture. No production scheduler changes; checkpoint 3 incomplete.
result: passed incrementally and once from a fresh directory containing the same five final source files
behavior: A separate native supervisor owns the target; Java owns the supervisor and attaches to the target grandchild.
Target lowers its own RLIMIT_AS soft limit to current virtual size plus 32 MiB. One caller-side malloc requests 268435456 bytes.
A native hook observes the real null result and errno 12, signals eventfd and blocks that allocation thread pending permission.
Java receives an authentic blocked frame containing a fresh token and target PID. An independent /bin/true process exits zero while allocation remains waiting.
Java posts matching token and fresh nonce. Target-side fixture restores the original soft limit and signals permission; the native hook retries the original malloc internally with the same size.
Java receives attempt 2 with a nonnull pointer, then releases the hook to return to the original caller.
Worker verifies first/last bytes, frees the block, verifies original limits restored and exits zero. Supervisor records actual terminal wait status zero; Java verifies target kernel PID absent.
Native API state queries confirm script already destroyed and session already detached after target exit; manager closes, dispatcher joins, Frida deinitializes and Java closes its arena.

diagnosed_probe_failures.change: Resolve exactly one matching owned-module function from enumerateExports.
diagnosed_probe_failures.attribution: Frida resolver internals remain unestablished; no claim of a confirmed upstream defect.

diagnosed_probe_failures.observation: Native hook reached genuine denial but Java message timed out. Diagnostic read result has JavaScript type object, string value 8 and strict comparison to numeric 8 false.
diagnosed_probe_failures.root_cause: Own probe compared Frida Int64 read/write return objects directly to JavaScript numbers.
diagnosed_probe_failures.change: Convert return values with toNumber before comparing eight-byte eventfd transfers.

diagnosed_probe_failures.observation: After worker exits zero, unconditional unload fails with FRIDA_ERROR_INVALID_OPERATION code 6, Script is destroyed.
diagnosed_probe_failures.root_cause: Probe tried to unload after target termination had automatically destroyed the script.
diagnosed_probe_failures.change: Use real is_destroyed/is_detached API queries before terminal cleanup; retain other API errors.

warnings: Original GNU-stack linker and JVM stack-guard warnings retained, not suppressed. Production link configuration remains open.
